title: Man City branded 'cheats' in hostile Liverpool reception after guilty verdict
summary: Manchester City were greeted with chants of "cheats" on their arrival at Anfield on Sunday to face Liverpool in their first game since being found guilty of breaking more than 100 financial rules.
